name: Yasovarman I
contribution: An Angkorian king who reigned in 889–910 CE.
legacy: His greatest achievement was to move the capital from Hariharalaya to Yashodharapura where it remained there for 600 years.

checks.lead: Yasovarman I (Khmer: ព្រះបាទយសោវរ្ម័នទី១) was an Angkorian king who reigned in 889–910 CE. He was called "Leper King".
